decisions.statement: The empty-page branch of the drain leaves the anchor where the anchor was.
An anchor advanced over an empty page puts every sample behind that anchor out of reach for good.
A failed upload leaves the anchor where the anchor was.
Every sample in a batch the server refused is fetched again by the next run.
The seed window bounds a read only where there is no anchor to bound that read.
A date window beside an anchor drops the samples a run after a long outage would recover.
A metric that sent nothing routes into the backstop before the run reports on that metric.
Nothing new to send is never reported on the anchored read's word alone.

definition: the Swift draining one metric from its anchor
